title: Post-Selected Weak-Value Phase Amplification vs. Total Per-Copy Fisher Information Conservation
claims: Post-selecting a weakly coupled pointer at small angle eps amplifies the conditional expectation contrast by O(1/eps) while reducing the acceptance probability as O(eps^2 + theta^2).

By the exact Fisher information chain rule I_total = P_acc * I_cond + I_binary(acc/rej) <= I_Q = gamma^2, post-selected weak-value amplification never exceeds the non-post-selected quantum Fisher information bound.
favorable_controls: Weak post-selection eps=0.02 vs balanced readout eps=pi/4 (where I_net == gamma^2)
